name: Hexarelin
description: Synthetic six-amino-acid growth hormone-releasing peptide (GHRP), related to GHRP-6

note.lead: The one sleep study was small.
note.text: In 7 healthy volunteers, deep sleep and EEG delta power fell after hexarelin. No registered trial was found.

bullets: **Strong GH release** in people after vein, skin, nasal or oral dosing
**Also raises** cortisol, ACTH and prolactin, not only growth hormone
**Heart studies** suggest direct action on heart-muscle GHS receptors
**GH response weakened** over 16 weeks of use and recovered after stopping

practical.routes: Into a vein, under the skin, nasal spray, by mouth (studies)
practical.soldAs: “Research use only” (not legal for human use)
practical.monitored: GH, IGF-1, cortisol, prolactin, ejection fraction

regulatory.text: Not on the 503A or 503B bulk lists

references: Frieboes et al., Psychoneuroendocrinology, hexarelin and sleep, Aug 2004
Rahim et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab, 16 weeks of hexarelin, May 1998
